plugins.name: verify-loop
plugins.description: Verify Loop: one place to verify a change or claim. It writes a check that can fail, loops until the check passes, keeps the proof, and returns a fixed answer (verdict, VERIFY: line, observed rejection, gaps). Users, skills and agents can all call it. Create mode generates a project /verify skill; maintain mode keeps it honest as the app changes. Also ships feature-map (manual-only): a FEATURES.md of every feature, its entry points and traces, checked against the code and linked to VERIFY.md. And latent-audit (manual-only): finds dead code and deletes a file only after a throwaway-copy deletion breaks none of the map's recorded runs, VERIFY.md checks or named commands. The install runs no hooks.
